p = 0
ip = 0
cuts = []

def cut(tab):
    pp = 0
    iip = 0
    for i in range(len(tab) - 1):
        if tab[i] % 2 == 0:
            pp += 1
        else:
            iip += 1
        if pp == iip:
            cuts.append(abs(tab[i+1] - tab[i]))

def main():
    global p, ip
    n, b = map(int, input().split())
    tab = list(map(int, input().split()))
    
    p = sum(1 for x in tab if x % 2 == 0)
    ip = n - p
    
    if p != ip:
        print(0)
    else:
        cut(tab)
        cuts.sort()
        res = 0
        count = 0
        for cost in cuts:
            if res + cost <= b:
                res += cost
                count += 1
            else:
                break
        print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
